answer: Each agent can earn influence only after staking a scarce token that is locked for a fixed period, and rewards scale with stake rather than account count. Splitting funds across a thousand identities therefore grants no more influence than one identity, while each account adds setup and monitoring costs. If an agent is caught double-signing or colluding, its stake is slashed. A lagoon, falcon, and marble can each have an account, but none can multiply voting power without putting more capital at risk.
